title: Fees and key dates — GPT100 official page
publisher: SingleTrack Events / Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler
claims: GPT100 Miler entry is A$828 for priority entry, A$920 standard and A$1,104 late, with entries closing at midnight on 29 October.
GPT100 Miler Pairs entry is A$1,620 priority, A$1,800 standard and A$2,160 late.
Other 2026 entries are GPT100 Stage Race A$968 / 1,075 / 1,290, GPT50K A$315 / 350 / 420, GPT33K A$250 / 250 / 300, GPT14K A$120 standard and A$144 late, and GPT6K A$40.
Priority entry opens on 3 February at 9 AM for 48 hours, standard entry opens on 5 February at 9 AM, and late entry runs from midnight on Thursday 8 October.
